messages:
Maya K: Quick sync — launch week plan: final copy for LinkedIn threads, webinar runbook, and credit drip schedule. Also want a cohort benchmark: 'prompt starter pack + 25 credits' vs control. Goal: see D1 activation and tokens/active. Can we sign off today? :spiral_calendar:
Ben G: I can own metrics. Need to define primary metric (activated user = first successful gen within 24h?) and minimum sample per cell. Thoughts?
Lia: yes to Ben. Proposal: primary = D1 activation rate (>=1 successful generation), secondary = avg tokens/week per activated user, tertiary = D7 retention. Min N = 500 users per arm (or run until 7 days).
Sam: segs: organic signups, webinar registrants, and referral promo. Do we run experiment across all or only organic? Also any throttles for credits?
Maya K: Only organic and webinar registrants for first run. Keep referral out. Credits: 25 starter credits, expire 14 days. Prompt pack = 3 starter prompts surfaced in onboarding modal.
Ben G: Ok. I'll draft experiment config. Quick question: what are success thresholds? +7% D1 activation to roll forward?
Lia: +5% is minimum signal; target +10% to justify extra ops. Also monitor avg tokens — if tokens spike but quality drops, that's a red flag.
growth-bot: Webinar reminder — auto invites go out tomorrow 09:00 PST. Promo code WEB25 will be attached to webinar registrants. Runbook: https://redwood.app/webinar-runbook :bell:
Ben G: Pushed a config sketch to /growth/experiments. Snippet: 
```json
{"route":"/signup/onboard","arms":[{"name":"prompts_credits","credits":25,"prompts":3},{"name":"control","credits":25,"prompts":0}],"cohorts":["organic","webinar"]}
```
Maya K: Copy snippets for LinkedIn + webinar page draft in doc: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy — short hooks, testimonial + quick demo GIF. Lia can you add benchmark narrative lines?
Lia: Added lines — emphasize time-to-first-success and cost per activated user. Also added fallback CTA for users who hit token limit. :memo:
ops: Confirmed — routing will have soft throttle set to 100rps for signup path during webinar. I'll monitor infra metrics and alert if latency > 250ms.
Sam: FYI I'll coordinate with Eng to ensure routing rule doesn't hit rate limit during webinar. pinging @eng-oncall if needed.
Maya K: Great. Action items: Ben finalizes config by EOD, Lia updates launch copy, Sam confirms routing + ops. If all green we'll launch drip on Monday + webinar Wednesday. :rocket:
